name: spydra-types-gen
comment: Isolated toolchain for `make types` (ADR-0013). openapi-typescript is hard-wired to the typescript JS API (ts.factory), which typescript@7 — the Go port the app packages pin, ADR-0017 — does not ship; npm cannot nest a peer override. Here typescript@5 is a direct dependency, so the peer resolves naturally while every app package keeps tsc 7.
